summary.text: Jason Ridley represents Georgia House District 6, which the legislature biography describes as including North Murray and Whitfield counties, and was sworn in on January 9, 2017.

paragraphs.text: Ridley is a native of Murray County who worked as a commercial and agricultural lender in community banking before starting the family business 4 Oaks Farm and Produce.
Ridley also owns and operates a small land clearing and development business.
